definition.additional: nominal genWeight*referenceWeight ratios with correlated ratio errors in CSV/JSON
definition.denominator: passesBaseline only; independent of c and reconstruction success; no extra jet gate
definition.efficiency: N(signal passes baseline and SR at c) / N(signal passes baseline)
definition.endpoints: Strict source cosine inequalities at every c; source guards: >14 ambiguous CA8 jets or >300 thrust particles; failures remain in denominator
definition.mass_plots: SR-selected reconstructed mass shapes, unit-area density, dashed nominal resonance mass; no ancestry truth overlay
definition.numerator: valid reconstruction, reco jet veto, >=1 medium b-tagged AK4, both SJ N(CA4 E>300 GeV)>=2
definition.primary: unweighted event counts with 68.27% Wilson intervals
definition.reconstruction: AN23-067-PATAK8-CA8-Thrust-source-port-v1; corrected selected PAT AK8 daughters; event CA8; SJ-rest CA4
definition.scope: 10,000-event representative subset per sample; three WbWb benchmarks; nominal UL2017 MC
definition.varied_parameter: Only the cosine threshold in the AN source-port partition; custom reconstruction settings do not enter the referenceScan branches
